Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01610219
Sheriff’s File # 26002021
PLAINTIFF – Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. vs:
DEFENDANTS- Carrie Carmack, et al
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 23rd day of November 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Neptune, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot 14 F/K/A Lot 1 Block 1612 F/K/A Block 3030 Tax Map of Township of Neptune
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1000 Fordham Road Neptune, NJ 07753
Dimensions: 100FT. X 100FT.
Nearest Cross Street: Halton Court
The occupancy status of the property is: OWNER OCCUPIED
Plaintiff's good faith estimate of its upset price is: $159,737.41.
Subject to a prior mortgage held by Wells Fargo, dated December 4, 2002, and recorded on December 23, 2002, in Mortgage Book 8173, Page 6192 with an outstanding balance of $135,735.76 through September 3, 2026. Successful purchaser takes subject to this mortgage and is responsible for obtaining the final payoff.
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY - INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE versus JACKSON FUNERAL HOME INC. a corporation, dated May 31, 2019, and recorded June 10, 2019, in Book OR-9352, Page 1963 in the amount of $180.59.
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY - INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE versus JACKSON FUNERAL HOME INC a corporation, dated July 11, 2018, and recorded July 24, 2018, in Book OR-9302, PAGE 2582 in the amount of $19,735.17.
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY - INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE versus JACKSONFUNERAL HOME INC a corporation dated October 31, 2017, and recorded November 6, 2017, in Book OR-9257, Page 8707 in the amount of $19,085.49.
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY - INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE versus JACKSON FUNERAL HOME INC a corporation date February 13, 2019, and recorded February 26, 2019, in Book OR-9337, Page 1347 in the amount of $1,003.28.
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY - INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE versus JACKSON FUNERAL HOME INC a corporation dated December 7, 2018, and recorded December 20, 2018 in Book OR-9327, Page 9760 in the amount of $515.97.
Pursuant to 28, U.S.C. Section 2410 (c), this sale is subject to a 120 day right of redemption held by the United States of America by virtue of the Internal Revenue Service Lien:" and delete the passage about "by virtue of its lien.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
**If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
**If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $158,398.12.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: October 1, 2026
Brock & Scott, PLLC
302 Fellowship Road Suite 130
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
888-461-7908
